notes.title: DoodleVR version 1.1 is live! With more languages...
notes.notes:
We have just released the first update for DoodleVR! Besides some small changes, the update includes 3 new languages (French, German and Dutch) for both the User Interface of the game and the (1500+) words that you have to draw. Thanks for all the feedback that we have received, we have tried to incorporate as many small fixes into this update as possible. We will keep working on the awesome features that you have proposed to us and we will keep adding more languages in future updates.

Have fun!
Amusez-vous!
Viel spaß!
Veel plezier!
